description: The touch screen map of QNC (user 2026-10-18: gestures are a block with their own map). A role is what a gesture of two or more fingers does over a panel: jog = the panel's wheel (the left/right arrow), level = Ctrl+wheel (the level of a taken A1/A2 sound), none = nothing. One finger is the pointer (a tap is a click, as the mouse).
